1.w: Then Moses sang—and the sons of Israel—this song to YHWH, and they spoke, saying: “I will sing to YHWH, for He has greatly triumphed; the horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea.

2.w: My strength and song [is] YAH, and He has become my salvation. This [is] my God, and I will praise Him, God of My father, and I will exalt Him.

3.w: YHWH [is] a man of war; YHWH [is] His name.

4.w: The chariots of Pharaoh and his army He has cast into the sea, and the choice of his captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

5.w: The depths cover them; they went down into the depths like a stone.

6.w: Your right hand, O YHWH, is glorious in power. Your right hand, O YHWH, shatters the enemy.

7.w: And in the greatness of Your excellence You overthrow those rising against You. You send forth Your burning anger; it consumes them like stubble.

8.w: And by the breath of Your nostrils the waters were gathered together; the flowing waters stood upright like a heap; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

9.w: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my soul shall be filled with them. I will draw my sword; my hand shall destroy them.’

10.w: You blew with Your breath; the sea covered them; they sank like lead in mighty waters.

11.w: Who [is] like You among the gods, O YHWH? Who [is] like You, majestic in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

12.w: You stretched out Your right hand; the earth swallowed them.

13.w: You have led forth in Your loving devotion the people whom You have redeemed; You have guided [them] in Your strength to Your holy habitation.

14.w: Peoples heard; they are troubled. Anguish seized those dwelling in Philistia.

15.w: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed; the mighty men of Moab; trembling seized them; all those dwelling in Canaan melted away.

16.w: Fear and dread will fall on them; by the greatness of Your arm they will be [as] still as a stone, until Your people pass over, O YHWH, until the people whom You have purchased pass over.

17.w: You will bring them in and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance—the place for Your own dwelling, [which] You have made, O YHWH, the sanctuary, O Lord, [that] Your hands have established.

18.w: YHWH shall reign forever and ever.”

19.w: For the horses of Pharaoh went in, with his chariots and with his horsemen, into the sea, and YHWH brought back upon them the waters of the sea, and the sons of Israel walked on the dry land in the midst of the sea.

20.w: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the timbrel in her hand, and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

21.w: And Miriam answered them, “Sing to YHWH, for He has greatly triumphed; the horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea.”

22.w: And Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the Wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness and found no water.

23.w: And they came to Marah, and they were not able to drink the waters of Marah, for they [were] bitter. (Upon thus its name was called Marah.)

24.w: And the people grumbled against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

25.w: And he cried out to YHWH, and YHWH showed him a tree, and he cast [it] into the waters, and the waters became sweet. There He made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there He tested them.

26.w: And He said, “If you will listen carefully to the voice of YHWH your God, and do what is right in His eyes, and you give ear to His commandments, and keep all His statutes; all of the diseases that I have brought on Egypt I will not put on you, for I [am] YHWH who heals you.”

27.w: And they came to Elim, and there [were] two [and] ten wells of water and seventy palm trees. And they camped there by the waters.
